recipes.title: Ground beef tacos
recipes.blurb: Classic weeknight crunchy tacos with all the toppings

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F for the taco shells.
Brown the beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, until no pink is left.
Spoon off the extra fat. Stir in the taco seasoning and water.
Simmer, stirring now and then, until the sauce thickens.
Stand the shells on a baking sheet and warm them in the oven.
Set out the cheese, lettuce, tomato, sour cream and salsa. Everyone builds their own.

recipes.title: Carne asada tacos
recipes.blurb: Citrus-marinated grilled steak on warm corn tortillas

steps.text: Whisk the juice of 2 limes, orange juice, garlic, cumin, chili powder, oil and salt in a dish.
Add the steak, turn to coat, and marinate in the fridge.
Heat a grill or cast iron pan to high heat.
Cook the steak 4 to 5 minutes per side for medium (130°F).
Rest the steak on a board, then slice thinly across the grain.
Warm the tortillas on the grill for 20 seconds per side.
Fill with steak, onion and cilantro. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Pork al pastor tacos
recipes.blurb: Chile-pineapple marinated pork, sheet-pan style

steps.text: Soak the guajillo chiles in hot water until soft.
Blend the chiles, chipotle, half the pineapple, vinegar, garlic, oregano, cumin and salt until smooth.
Coat the pork in the marinade. Refrigerate at least 1 hour, up to overnight.
Heat the oven to 450°F. Spread the pork in one layer on a lined sheet pan.
Roast until browned at the edges and 145°F inside, adding the rest of the pineapple halfway.
Chop the pork and pineapple. Pile onto warm tortillas with onion and cilantro.

recipes.title: Slow cooker carnitas tacos
recipes.blurb: Fall-apart pork crisped under the broiler

steps.text: Rub the pork with salt, cumin and oregano.
Put the onion and garlic in the slow cooker. Add the pork and pour the orange and lime juice over it.
Cook on low until the pork shreds easily.
Shred the pork with two forks and stir it in the juices.
Spread the pork on a sheet pan and broil until the tips crisp.
Warm the tortillas and fill with pork and cilantro.

recipes.title: Baja fish tacos
recipes.blurb: Crispy cod with crunchy slaw and a creamy lime sauce

steps.text: Stir the mayonnaise, sour cream and juice of 1 lime into a sauce. Toss the cabbage with a spoonful of it.
Whisk 3/4 cup flour, chili powder, salt and beer into a smooth batter.
Heat the oil in a deep skillet to 375°F.
Dust the fish with the remaining flour, dip in batter and fry in batches until golden. Fish should reach 145°F.
Drain the fish on paper towels. Warm the tortillas.
Fill with fish, slaw and sauce. Squeeze lime over the top.

recipes.title: Chicken tinga tacos
recipes.blurb: Smoky chipotle-tomato shredded chicken

steps.text: Cover the chicken with water in a pot, add the salt and simmer until 165°F inside.
Shred the chicken with two forks.
Heat the oil in a skillet and cook the onion until soft. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Blend the tomatoes, chipotles, adobo sauce and oregano until smooth. Pour into the skillet.
Add the chicken and simmer until the sauce clings to it.
Serve on warm tortillas with cotija and avocado.

recipes.title: Garlic-lime shrimp tacos
recipes.blurb: Quick skillet shrimp with a cool mango salsa

steps.text: Toss the shrimp with the oil, garlic, chili powder, salt and half the lime juice.
Mix the mango, red onion, cilantro and remaining lime juice for the salsa.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook the shrimp until pink and curled, about 2 minutes per side.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with cabbage, shrimp and mango salsa.

recipes.title: Sweet potato black bean tacos
recipes.blurb: Roasted sweet potato with smoky beans and lime crema

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the sweet potatoes with oil, chili powder, cumin and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast, stirring once, until tender and browned.
Warm the black beans in a small pot.
Stir the sour cream and lime juice together.
Fill warm tortillas with potatoes, beans, avocado, crema and cilantro.

recipes.title: Egg and chorizo breakfast tacos
recipes.blurb: Scrambled eggs, spicy chorizo and potatoes in a warm tortilla

steps.text: Cook the potato in a skillet over medium heat until golden and tender.
Add the chorizo and cook, breaking it up, until cooked through.
Whisk the eggs with the milk and salt.
Pour the eggs over the chorizo and stir gently until just set.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with eggs, cheese and salsa.

recipes.title: Chorizo and potato tacos
recipes.blurb: Crispy taco-stand favorite on corn tortillas

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water until just tender, then drain.
Cook the chorizo in a skillet over medium heat, breaking it up, until cooked through.
Add the potatoes and cook, stirring, until crisp at the edges.
Warm the tortillas in a hot dry skillet, 20 seconds per side.
Fill with the chorizo and potatoes, then top with onion and cilantro.
Serve with lime wedges and salsa verde.

recipes.title: Red chicken enchiladas
recipes.blurb: Rolled tortillas with chicken, cheese and red enchilada sauce

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Grease a 9x13 baking dish and spread 1/2 cup sauce in the bottom.
Mix the chicken, 1 cup cheese, sour cream, green chiles and cumin.
Spoon filling down the middle of each tortilla and roll up. Set seam side down in the dish.
Pour the remaining sauce over the top and sprinkle with 2 cups cheese.
Cover with foil and bake 15 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake until bubbly.
Top with cilantro and let rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken enchiladas suizas
recipes.blurb: Creamy green tomatillo sauce with melted Monterey Jack

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Simmer tomatillos, jalapeños, onion and garlic in water until soft.
Blend the cooked vegetables with the cilantro, cream and salt until smooth.
Warm the tortillas in a skillet with the oil until pliable.
Dip each tortilla in the sauce, fill with chicken and a little cheese, and roll.
Place seam side down in a baking dish. Pour on the remaining sauce and cheese.
Bake until bubbly and lightly browned.

recipes.title: Cheese enchiladas
recipes.blurb: Gooey cheddar and Jack enchiladas in a quick chili gravy

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Spread 1/2 cup sauce in a 9x13 baking dish.
Warm the sauce in a wide skillet. Heat the tortillas in the oil, a few seconds per side, until soft.
Dip each tortilla in warm sauce. Fill with cheddar, Jack and a little onion, then roll up.
Lay the enchiladas seam side down in the dish. Pour the rest of the sauce over them.
Top with the remaining cheddar and olives.
Bake until the cheese is bubbling.
Serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Ground beef enchiladas
recipes.blurb: Seasoned beef and cheese under red sauce

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Brown the beef and onion in a skillet until no pink is left. Drain the fat.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, salt and 1/2 cup sauce.
Spread 1/2 cup sauce in a 9x13 dish. Fill each tortilla with beef and a little cheese, roll, and set in the dish.
Pour on the remaining sauce and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake until hot and bubbly.

recipes.title: Spinach and black bean enchiladas
recipes.blurb: Meatless enchiladas packed with greens and beans

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Warm the oil in a skillet. Cook the garlic 30 seconds, then add the spinach and cook until wilted.
Stir in the beans, corn, cumin and 1 cup cheese.
Spread 1/2 cup sauce in a 9x13 dish. Fill and roll each tortilla, placing seam side down.
Top with the remaining sauce and cheese.
Bake until bubbly.

recipes.title: Chicken enchilada casserole
recipes.blurb: Layered, no-roll version that feeds a crowd

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Grease a 9x13 baking dish.
Mix the chicken, beans, corn and cumin.
Spread 1/2 cup sauce in the dish and cover with half the tortillas.
Layer half the chicken mix, 1 cup cheese and some sauce. Repeat the layers.
Finish with the last sauce and cheese. Cover with foil.
Bake covered 20 minutes, then uncover and bake until bubbly.
Bake uncovered. Rest 5 minutes and serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Smothered beef burritos
recipes.blurb: Stuffed with beef and rice, topped with sauce and cheese

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Brown the beef in a skillet until no pink is left. Drain. Add the seasoning and water and simmer until thick.
Warm the tortillas in the microwave so they fold without cracking.
Spread beans on each tortilla. Add beef, rice and a little cheese. Fold in the sides and roll up.
Set the burritos seam side down in a baking dish. Cover with enchilada sauce and the remaining cheese.
Bake until the cheese melts and the sauce bubbles.

recipes.title: Bean and rice burritos
recipes.blurb: Freezer-friendly vegetarian burritos

steps.text: Warm the beans with the cumin and chili powder, mashing about half of them.
Stir the salsa into the cooked rice.
Warm the tortillas in the microwave until soft.
Fill each with rice, beans, cheese and avocado.
Fold in the sides, roll tightly, and set seam side down.
Toast the burritos in a dry skillet until golden on each side.

recipes.title: Baked chicken chimichangas
recipes.blurb: Crisp oven-baked burritos filled with cheesy chicken

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a sheet pan with parchment.
Mix the chicken, salsa, beans, cheese and cumin.
Warm the tortillas until soft. Spoon filling in the center of each.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Place seam side down on the pan.
Brush all over with the oil.
Bake until golden and crisp, turning once.
Serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Black bean and cheese quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Crispy skillet quesadillas with corn and green onion

steps.text: Lightly mash the black beans with a fork. Stir in the corn, green onions, cumin and chili powder.
Spread the beans over 4 tortillas. Top with the cheese, then the other 4 tortillas.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat with a little of the oil.
Cook one quesadilla until golden underneath and the cheese starts to melt.
Flip it carefully with a wide spatula and cook the other side.
Repeat with the rest. Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Chicken quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Melty cheese and seasoned chicken in a crisp tortilla

steps.text: Toss the chicken with chili powder, cumin and salt.
Cook the chicken and pepper in the oil over medium-high heat until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Wipe out the skillet. Place a tortilla in it and cover half with cheese and a quarter of the chicken.
Fold over and cook until golden, then flip and cook the other side.
Repeat with the remaining tortillas.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.title: Chicken burrito bowls
recipes.blurb: Cilantro-lime rice, black beans and grilled chili-lime chicken

steps.text: Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp oil, chili powder, cumin, salt and juice of 1 lime. Let it sit while the rice cooks.
Bring the rice, water and a pinch of salt to a boil, cover, and cook on low until tender.
Cook the chicken in a hot skillet with the remaining oil until 165°F inside.
Rest the chicken, then slice. Stir the cilantro and the juice of 2 limes into the rice.
Warm the beans and corn together.
Fill bowls with rice, chicken, beans, corn, avocado and salsa.

recipes.title: Steak burrito bowls
recipes.blurb: Seared sirloin over rice with peppers and onions

steps.text: Rub the steak with chili powder, cumin and salt.
Sear the steak in 1 tbsp oil over high heat, 4 minutes per side for medium (130°F).
Rest the steak, then slice thinly across the grain.
Cook the peppers and onion in the remaining oil until soft and charred at the edges.
Warm the beans and rice together with the lime juice.
Build bowls with rice and beans, steak and vegetables, cheese and salsa.

recipes.title: Sweet potato burrito bowls
recipes.blurb: Roasted sweet potato, black beans, rice and avocado

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the sweet potatoes with oil, chili powder, cumin and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast, stirring once, until tender and browned.
Warm the beans with a splash of water.
Stir the lime juice and cilantro into the rice.
Fill bowls with rice, potatoes, beans, avocado and salsa.

recipes.title: Taco salad bowls
recipes.blurb: Seasoned beef over romaine with chips, cheese and salsa

steps.text: Brown the beef in a skillet until no pink is left (160°F). Drain the fat.
Stir in the taco seasoning and water. Simmer until thick.
Divide the lettuce, tomatoes and beans among four bowls.
Top with warm beef and cheese.
Add the tortilla chips, salsa and sour cream just before serving.

recipes.title: Loaded sheet-pan nachos
recipes.blurb: Chips, beans, melted cheese and all the toppings

ingredients.item: cooked seasoned ground beef or shredded chicken

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Line a large sheet pan with parchment.
Spread half the chips on the pan. Top with half the beans, meat and cheese.
Add the rest of the chips and layer on the remaining beans, meat and cheese. Add the jalapeño.
Bake until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Top with tomatoes, avocado, sour cream and cilantro. Serve right away.

recipes.title: Chilaquiles verdes
recipes.blurb: Crisp tortilla chips simmered in tangy salsa verde, with eggs

steps.text: Simmer the salsa verde and broth in a wide skillet for 3 minutes.
Fold in the chips until coated. Cook just until slightly softened but still with some bite.
Fry the eggs in the oil in another skillet, sunny side up.
Divide the chilaquiles onto plates and top with the eggs.
Finish with cotija, sour cream, onion and cilantro.

recipes.title: Black bean tostadas
recipes.blurb: Crunchy tostada shells with beans, cabbage and avocado

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Set the tostada shells on a baking sheet.
Warm the beans in a small pot.
Spread beans on each shell and sprinkle with the Mexican cheese.
Bake until the cheese melts.
Toss the cabbage with the lime juice.
Top with cabbage, avocado, salsa, cotija and cilantro.

recipes.title: Chicken tortilla soup
recipes.blurb: Tomato-chile broth with shredded chicken and crunchy tortilla strips

ingredients.item: diced tomatoes with green chiles (10 oz)

steps.text: Cook the onion in the oil in a large pot until soft. Add the garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth and chicken breasts. Bring to a boil.
Reduce to a simmer until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Move the chicken to a board and shred it.
Return the chicken to the pot with the beans and corn. Heat through.
Stir in the lime juice. Serve topped with tortilla strips, avocado and cilantro.

recipes.title: Easy taco soup
recipes.blurb: Dump-and-simmer soup with beef, beans and corn

ingredients.item: diced tomatoes with green chiles (10 oz)

steps.text: Brown the beef and onion in a large pot until no pink is left. Drain the fat.
Stir in the taco seasoning.
Add the tomatoes, all the beans, corn and broth. Bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer, stirring now and then.
Ladle into bowls. Top with cheese, sour cream and chips.

recipes.title: Pozole rojo
recipes.blurb: Hominy and pork in a rich red chile broth

steps.text: Put the pork, half the onion, 3 garlic cloves, salt and water in a large pot. Bring to a boil, then simmer.
Meanwhile, soak the chiles in hot water until soft.
Blend the chiles with the remaining onion and garlic, oregano and 1 cup of the soaking water until smooth. Strain.
Stir the chile sauce into the pot with the hominy.
Simmer until the pork is tender, adding water if needed.
Serve with cabbage, radishes and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Albondigas soup
recipes.blurb: Mexican meatball soup with rice and vegetables

steps.text: Mix the beef, pork, 1/4 cup rice, egg, mint and salt. Roll into 1-inch meatballs.
Cook the onion and carrots in the oil in a large pot until softening.
Add the tomato sauce, broth and cumin. Bring to a boil.
Drop in the meatballs and the remaining rice. Simmer gently.
Add the zucchini and cook until tender. Meatballs should reach 160°F.
Taste for salt and serve hot.

recipes.title: Black bean soup
recipes.blurb: Smoky, creamy soup from pantry staples

steps.text: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin and oregano and stir for 1 minute.
Add 2 cans of beans and the broth. Bring to a boil, then simmer.
Blend with an immersion blender until mostly smooth.
Stir in the last can of beans, salt and lime juice. Heat through.
Serve with sour cream and cilantro.

recipes.title: Texas chili con carne
recipes.blurb: Hearty beef chili with chiles and a long, slow simmer

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in 1 tbsp oil in a large pot. Set aside.
Cook the onions in the remaining oil until soft. Add the garlic, chili powder, cumin and oregano.
Add the tomato paste, tomatoes, broth, salt and the beef.
Bring to a boil, cover partly and simmer until the beef is very tender.
Stir the masa harina with a little water and stir it in to thicken.
Taste and adjust salt. Serve with your favorite toppings.

recipes.title: White chicken chili
recipes.blurb: Creamy green chile and white bean chili

steps.text: Cook the onion in the oil in a large pot until soft. Add the garlic, chiles, cumin and oregano.
Add the beans with their liquid and the broth. Bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes. Mash some of the beans against the pot to thicken.
Stir in the chicken, cream cheese and corn until the cheese melts.
Finish with lime juice and cilantro.

recipes.title: Sopa de fideo
recipes.blurb: Toasted noodles in a mild tomato broth

ingredients.item: fideo or broken angel hair pasta

steps.text: Heat the oil in a pot and toast the noodles, stirring, until golden brown.
Add the onion and garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato sauce, broth, cumin and salt.
Bring to a boil, then simmer until the noodles are tender.
Serve with cilantro and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Caldo de pollo
recipes.blurb: Mexican chicken soup with corn, potatoes and carrots

steps.text: Put the chicken, water, onion, garlic and salt in a large pot. Bring to a boil and skim any foam.
Reduce the heat and simmer until the chicken is cooked (165°F).
Add the carrots, potatoes and corn. Simmer until nearly tender.
Add the zucchini and cook until tender.
Serve in big bowls with cilantro and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Beef birria stew
recipes.blurb: Chile-braised beef for tacos or sipping broth

steps.text: Heat the oven to 325°F. Toast the dried chiles in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side, then soak in hot water.
Blend the chiles with the chipotle, onion, garlic, vinegar, oregano, cumin and 1 cup of broth until smooth.
Salt the beef and put it in a Dutch oven with the sauce, bay leaves and remaining broth.
Cover and braise in the oven until the beef falls apart.
Shred the beef in the pot and discard the bay leaves.
Serve in bowls with lime, or on tortillas with the broth for dipping.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan chicken fajitas
recipes.blurb: Everything roasts together on one pan

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a large sheet pan with foil.
Put the chicken, peppers and onion on the pan. Add the oil and all the spices and toss to coat.
Spread everything out in one layer so it roasts instead of steaming.
Roast for 20 minutes, stirring halfway. The chicken is done at 165°F inside.
Wrap the tortillas in foil and warm them in the turned-off oven while you set the table.
Squeeze lime over the pan. Fill the tortillas and add sour cream and salsa.

recipes.title: Skillet steak fajitas
recipes.blurb: Sizzling flank steak with peppers and onions

steps.text: Mix 1 tbsp oil, lime juice, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder and salt. Rub it on the steak and let it sit.
Heat a large cast iron skillet over high heat with 1 tbsp oil.
Sear the steak 4 to 5 minutes per side for medium (130°F).
Rest the steak on a board. Slice thinly across the grain.
Cook the peppers and onion in the remaining oil until charred and tender.
Warm the tortillas. Serve the steak and vegetables with guacamole.

recipes.title: Arroz con pollo
recipes.blurb: One-pot chicken and tomato rice

steps.text: Season the chicken with the salt. Brown it skin side down in the oil in a Dutch oven. Set aside.
Cook the onion and pepper in the drippings until soft. Add the garlic.
Stir in the rice, cumin and paprika and toast for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce and broth. Nestle the chicken on top and bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on low until the rice is tender and the chicken is 165°F.
Scatter the peas on top, cover, and let sit off the heat.

recipes.title: Pollo asado
recipes.blurb: Citrus-achiote grilled chicken

steps.text: Whisk the juices, garlic, oil, achiote, cumin, oregano and salt until the achiote dissolves.
Add the chicken and turn to coat. Marinate in the fridge, 4 hours or overnight.
Heat the grill to medium and oil the grates.
Grill the chicken skin side down, then turn every 10 minutes.
Check that the thickest part reaches 165°F. Rest before serving.

recipes.title: Easy chicken mole
recipes.blurb: Chocolate-chile sauce over tender chicken, simplified

steps.text: Season the chicken with salt. Brown it in the oil in a Dutch oven and set aside.
Cook the onion and garlic in the drippings until soft.
Blend the onion mixture with chili powder, peanut butter, tomatoes, broth and cinnamon until smooth.
Pour the sauce into the pot, add the chicken, and simmer covered until 165°F.
Stir in the chocolate until melted.
Serve over rice, sprinkled with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Pork chile verde
recipes.blurb: Tender pork in a bright tomatillo-poblano sauce

steps.text: Season the pork with salt and brown in the oil in a Dutch oven, in batches.
Broil the tomatillos, poblanos, jalapeños, onion and garlic until charred in spots.
Blend the vegetables with cumin, oregano, cilantro and broth until smooth.
Pour the sauce over the pork. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer until very tender.
Serve with rice and warm tortillas.

recipes.title: Slow cooker beef barbacoa
recipes.blurb: Chipotle-spiced shredded beef for tacos and bowls

steps.text: Blend the chipotles, broth, lime juice, garlic, vinegar, cumin, oregano and salt until smooth.
Put the beef and bay leaves in the slow cooker and pour on the sauce.
Cook on low until the beef shreds easily.
Remove the bay leaves. Shred the beef and stir into the juices.
Serve in tacos, burritos or bowls.

recipes.title: Carne guisada
recipes.blurb: Tex-Mex beef stew with potatoes in a rich gravy

steps.text: Toss the beef with the flour. Brown it in the oil in a Dutch oven, in batches.
Cook the onion and pepper in the pot until soft. Add the garlic, chili powder and cumin.
Return the beef. Add the tomatoes, broth and salt.
Cover and simmer on low until the beef is nearly tender.
Add the potatoes and cook until tender.
Serve with warm flour tortillas or rice.

recipes.title: Beef picadillo
recipes.blurb: Savory-sweet ground beef with potatoes, olives and raisins

steps.text: Brown the beef and onion in a large skillet until no pink is left (160°F). Drain.
Add the garlic, cumin, oregano and salt and stir for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, tomato sauce and water. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the olives and raisins. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Slow cooker salsa verde chicken
recipes.blurb: Two ingredients plus tortillas make an easy dinner

steps.text: Put the chicken in the slow cooker and sprinkle with cumin, garlic powder and salt.
Pour the salsa verde over the top.
Cook on low until the chicken is tender and 165°F inside.
Shred the chicken in the pot and stir it in the sauce.
Serve in warm tortillas with cotija and cilantro.

recipes.title: Mexican red rice
recipes.blurb: Fluffy tomato rice, the classic side

steps.text: Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Toast the rice, stirring, until light golden.
Add the onion and garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato sauce, broth, cumin and salt. Bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on very low heat until the liquid is absorbed.
Rest covered off the heat, then fluff with a fork.

recipes.title: Cilantro-lime rice
recipes.blurb: Fresh, zesty rice for bowls and burritos

steps.text: Rinse the rice in a strainer until the water runs mostly clear.
Bring the rice, water, oil and salt to a boil. Cover and reduce the heat to low.
Cook until the water is absorbed.
Rest covered off the heat.
Fluff with a fork and stir in the cilantro, lime juice and zest.

recipes.title: Homemade refried beans
recipes.blurb: Creamy pinto beans mashed with onion and garlic

steps.text: Heat the oil in a skillet and cook the onion until soft. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the beans, cumin, salt and 1/2 cup of the bean liquid.
Simmer for 5 minutes, then mash with a potato masher until as smooth as you like.
Add more bean liquid if too thick.
Top with the cheese and let it melt.

recipes.title: Charro beans
recipes.blurb: Pinto beans simmered with bacon, tomato and jalapeño

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a large pot until crisp.
Add the onion, garlic and jalapeño and cook until soft.
Add the beans, water and cumin. Bring to a boil.
Reduce to a gentle simmer, partly covered, until the beans are almost tender.
Add the tomatoes and salt and cook until the beans are creamy.
Stir in the cilantro and serve.

recipes.title: Classic guacamole
recipes.blurb: Chunky and bright with lime and cilantro

steps.text: Halve the avocados and scoop them into a bowl.
Add the lime juice and salt. Mash with a fork, leaving some chunks.
Fold in the onion, jalapeño, cilantro and tomato.
Taste and add more salt or lime. Serve right away.

recipes.title: Pico de gallo
recipes.blurb: Fresh tomato salsa that goes on everything

steps.text: Dice the tomatoes and put them in a bowl.
Add the onion, jalapeño and cilantro.
Stir in the lime juice and salt.
Let it sit so the flavors blend.
Taste and adjust the salt and lime.

recipes.title: Restaurant-style salsa roja
recipes.blurb: Blender salsa with canned tomatoes and a little heat

steps.text: Put the tomatoes with their juice in a blender.
Add the onion, jalapeño, garlic, cilantro, lime juice, cumin and salt.
Pulse until it reaches the texture you like.
Chill before serving so the flavors blend.

recipes.title: Roasted salsa verde
recipes.blurb: Tangy charred tomatillo salsa

steps.text: Heat the broiler. Put the tomatillos, jalapeños, onion and garlic on a sheet pan.
Broil until charred in spots, then flip and broil the other side.
Peel the garlic.
Blend everything with the cilantro, lime juice and salt until smooth.
Taste, adjust the salt, and chill.

recipes.title: Esquites (Mexican street corn cups)
recipes.blurb: Charred corn with lime, mayo and cotija

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large skillet over high heat.
Add the corn in a single layer and cook without stirring until charred.
Stir and cook a few more minutes until browned in spots.
Mix the corn with the mayonnaise, lime juice, chili powder and salt.
Top with cotija and cilantro. Serve warm in cups.

recipes.title: Chile con queso
recipes.blurb: Smooth, creamy cheese dip with green chiles

ingredients.item: diced tomatoes with green chiles (10 oz)

steps.text: Put the cheese, tomatoes and green chiles, milk and cumin in a saucepan over low heat.
Stir often until the cheese melts and the dip is smooth.
Thin with a splash more milk if needed.
Stir in the cilantro. Serve warm with chips.

recipes.title: Crispy baked chicken tacos
recipes.blurb: Taco-seasoned chicken in crunchy shells, topped your way

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Stir the taco seasoning into the crushed chips on a plate.
Toss the chicken strips in the salsa, then press each into the chip mix.
Lay the strips on the sheet and bake until crisp and 165°F inside.
Warm the taco shells in the oven for the last 3 minutes.
Fill shells with chicken, lettuce, cheese and sour cream.

recipes.title: Lime flank steak tacos
recipes.blurb: Citrus-marinated steak, seared hot and sliced thin

steps.text: Mix lime juice, olive oil, garlic, cumin, chili powder and the salt in a zip bag.
Add the steak and marinate in the fridge.
Heat a grill or cast-iron pan to high and sear the steak 4 to 5 minutes per side for medium (145°F).
Rest the steak, then slice thinly against the grain.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until soft and lightly charred.
Fill with steak, onion and cilantro.

recipes.title: Slow cooker shredded beef tacos
recipes.blurb: Fall-apart chuck roast in a smoky chili sauce

ingredients.item: diced tomatoes with green chiles (10 oz)

steps.text: Rub the beef with salt, chili powder and cumin.
Put onion and garlic in the slow cooker, then add the beef, tomatoes and broth.
Cook on low until the beef shreds easily.
Shred the beef with two forks and stir it into the juices.
Warm the tortillas and fill with beef and cheese.

recipes.title: Ground turkey tacos
recipes.blurb: Lean, speedy tacos with a little hidden veggie

steps.text: Brown the turkey and onion in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Stir in the zucchini and cook until soft.
Add taco seasoning and water, then simmer until thick. Turkey must reach 165°F.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with turkey, avocado and salsa.

recipes.title: Blackened fish tacos with mango slaw
recipes.blurb: Spiced seared cod with a sweet, crunchy slaw

steps.text: Toss the slaw mix, mango, cilantro and juice of 1 lime with a pinch of the salt.
Mix paprika, garlic powder, cayenne and the rest of the salt, then rub on the cod.
Sear the cod in hot oil 3 to 4 minutes per side until it flakes and reaches 145°F.
Warm the tortillas and flake the fish into chunks.
Fill tortillas with fish and slaw and squeeze over the other lime.

recipes.title: Roasted poblano and black bean tacos
recipes.blurb: Smoky peppers, beans and melty cheese

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the poblanos and onion with oil, cumin and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast until browned at the edges.
Warm the beans in a small pot and mash them slightly.
Fill warm tortillas with beans, peppers and cheese, then add sour cream and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Crispy potato tacos
recipes.blurb: Spiced mashed potato folded in tortillas and pan-fried

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water until fork tender, then drain.
Mash with chili powder, salt and cheese.
Warm tortillas, spoon potato onto one half and fold.
Fry the tacos in hot oil until golden, 2 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels and top with lettuce and salsa.

recipes.title: Slow cooker chicken tacos
recipes.blurb: Dump-and-go salsa chicken for easy taco night

steps.text: Put the chicken in the slow cooker and sprinkle with taco seasoning.
Pour the salsa, beans and corn over the top.
Cook on low until the chicken is 165°F and shreds easily.
Shred the chicken in the pot and stir it into the sauce.
Serve in warm tortillas with cheese and sour cream.

recipes.title: Cauliflower tacos with chipotle crema
recipes.blurb: Crisp-roasted spiced cauliflower with a smoky cream

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the cauliflower with oil, chili powder, cumin and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast, stirring once, until browned and tender.
Stir the sour cream, chipotle and lime juice together for the crema.
Warm tortillas and fill with cauliflower, cabbage and crema.

recipes.title: Pork tenderloin tacos
recipes.blurb: Chili-rubbed pork seared and sliced with pineapple salsa

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Rub the pork with chili powder, cumin and salt.
Sear in an oven-safe skillet with oil for 2 minutes per side.
Roast until the pork reaches 145°F, then rest.
Mix pineapple, onion, cilantro and lime juice.
Slice the pork and serve in warm tortillas with salsa.

recipes.title: Air fryer cod tacos
recipes.blurb: Crunchy breaded cod with a lime-cabbage topping

steps.text: Heat the air fryer to 400°F.
Mix panko with chili powder and a pinch of salt.
Dredge cod strips in flour, then egg, then panko.
Spray with cooking spray and air fry in a single layer, flipping once, until 145°F inside.
Stir cabbage, mayonnaise and lime juice together.
Fill warm tortillas with fish and cabbage.

recipes.title: Layered taco bake
recipes.blurb: Seasoned beef, beans, tortillas and cheese baked bubbly

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Brown the beef in a skillet, drain, then stir in taco seasoning, beans, salsa and 0.5 cup water.
Spread a little enchilada sauce in a 9x13 dish and add a layer of tortillas.
Layer half the beef, a third of the cheese, then repeat with tortillas, beef and sauce.
Top with remaining cheese and the chips.
Bake until bubbly and the center is 165°F.

recipes.title: Green chile chicken enchiladas
recipes.blurb: Mild green chiles, cream cheese and salsa verde

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Mix chicken, chiles, cream cheese and 1 cup cheese.
Spread 0.5 cup salsa verde in a 9x13 dish.
Roll the filling into tortillas and set them seam side down in the dish.
Pour over remaining salsa verde and top with remaining cheese.
Bake until bubbly and the filling is 165°F.
Top with sour cream and cilantro.

recipes.title: Sour cream chicken enchiladas
recipes.blurb: Creamy, cheesy and mild for the whole table

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, then add the broth and simmer until thick.
Off the heat, stir in sour cream and chiles.
Mix the chicken with 1 cup cheese and 0.5 cup sauce, then roll into tortillas.
Set seam side down in a 9x13 dish, pour over remaining sauce and add remaining cheese.
Bake until bubbling and 165°F inside.

recipes.title: Pork enchiladas verdes
recipes.blurb: Tender pork in tangy tomatillo sauce

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Warm the pork with the onion, cumin and 0.5 cup salsa verde in a pan.
Soften each tortilla in hot oil for 10 seconds per side, then drain.
Fill with pork and a little cheese, roll and place seam down in a 9x13 dish.
Pour over remaining salsa and cheese.
Bake until bubbly.
Drizzle with crema before serving.

recipes.title: Mushroom and poblano enchiladas
recipes.blurb: Meaty mushrooms and roasted peppers, no meat needed

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Cook mushrooms, poblanos and onion in oil with cumin until the liquid has cooked off.
Stir 1 cup cheese into the filling.
Warm the tortillas, fill, roll and set seam down in a dish with a little sauce.
Cover with remaining sauce and cheese.
Bake until bubbly.

recipes.title: Beef and bean burritos
recipes.blurb: Freezer-friendly burritos stuffed with seasoned beef

steps.text: Brown the beef in a skillet and drain.
Stir in taco seasoning, beans and salsa and heat through. Beef must reach 160°F.
Warm the tortillas so they bend without cracking.
Layer rice, filling and cheese on each, fold in the sides and roll tight.
Sear the burritos seam side down in a dry skillet until golden.

recipes.title: Beef chimichangas
recipes.blurb: Crispy fried burritos filled with spiced shredded beef

steps.text: Warm the beef with salsa and cumin until most liquid evaporates.
Warm the tortillas, then add beef and cheese to each.
Fold in the sides and roll tight, securing with a toothpick.
Heat the oil in a deep skillet to 350°F.
Fry the chimichangas until golden, turning once.
Drain on paper towels and serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Wet chicken burritos
recipes.blurb: Burritos smothered in red sauce and melted cheese

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Mix chicken, rice, beans, 1 cup cheese and 0.5 cup sauce.
Roll the filling into the warm tortillas and place seam down in a baking dish.
Pour over the rest of the sauce and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake until bubbling and 165°F in the center.
Sprinkle with cilantro.

recipes.title: Burrito casserole
recipes.blurb: Everything in a burrito, baked in one dish

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Brown the beef, drain, then stir in taco seasoning, beans, rice and salsa.
Layer half the tortillas, filling, sauce and cheese in a 9x13 dish.
Repeat the layers and finish with cheese.
Cover with foil and bake, then uncover for the last 10 minutes. Center must be 160°F.

recipes.title: Tamale pie
recipes.blurb: Chili beef under a golden cornbread crust

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Brown the beef and onion, drain, then stir in chili powder, tomatoes and corn.
Simmer until thickened and spread in a greased 9x13 dish.
Stir the cornbread mix with the egg and milk, then spoon over the beef and sprinkle cheese.
Bake until the crust is golden and the filling is 160°F.

recipes.title: Baked chicken flautas
recipes.blurb: Crunchy rolled tacos, no frying needed

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F and grease a baking sheet.
Stir the chicken, cream cheese, salsa verde and cheese together.
Warm tortillas, spoon filling along one edge and roll tight.
Place seam down on the sheet and spray with cooking spray.
Bake until crisp and golden and the filling is 165°F.
Serve with guacamole.

recipes.title: Carnitas burrito bowls
recipes.blurb: Crisped pork over rice, beans and fresh toppings

steps.text: Crisp the carnitas in a hot nonstick skillet until browned in spots and 165°F.
Warm the rice, beans and corn separately.
Divide rice into four bowls.
Top with pork, beans, corn, avocado and pico de gallo.
Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Shrimp burrito bowls
recipes.blurb: Chili-lime shrimp over cilantro rice

steps.text: Toss the shrimp with chili powder, oil and a pinch of salt.
Cook in a hot skillet until pink and opaque, 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Stir the cilantro and juice of 1 lime into the warm rice.
Heat the beans in a small pot.
Build bowls with rice, beans, shrimp, avocado and salsa, with the second lime juiced over the top.

recipes.title: Mexican quinoa bowls
recipes.blurb: Protein-packed vegan bowls with chipotle dressing

steps.text: Simmer the quinoa with the water and half the salt, covered, until the water is absorbed.
Rest the quinoa off the heat, then fluff.
Whisk lime juice, oil, chili powder and remaining salt.
Toss the quinoa with beans, corn, pepper, cilantro and dressing.
Top with avocado.

recipes.title: Chicken street corn bowls
recipes.blurb: Esquites-style corn and chili-lime chicken over rice

steps.text: Season the chicken with chili powder and salt and sear in oil 6 minutes per side until 165°F.
Rest the chicken and slice.
Char the corn in a dry hot skillet until browned in spots.
Stir the corn with mayonnaise, half the cotija and juice of 1 lime.
Serve over rice with chicken, remaining cotija, cilantro and lime.

recipes.title: Steak and pepper quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Seared steak, sweet peppers and melty cheese

steps.text: Sear the steak with cumin and salt in hot oil until browned and 145°F, about 4 minutes.
Cook the pepper and onion in the same pan until soft.
Sprinkle cheese over half of each tortilla, add steak and veggies, and fold.
Cook each quesadilla in a dry skillet until golden, 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Slice into wedges and serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Shrimp quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Garlicky shrimp and cheese in crisp tortillas

steps.text: Cook the shrimp with garlic, chili powder and oil until opaque.
Sprinkle cheese and shrimp over half of each tortilla and fold.
Toast in a skillet over medium heat until golden, 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan quesadillas
recipes.blurb: One big pan feeds the whole family at once

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F and spray a large sheet pan.
Lay 2 tortillas on the pan so they hang over the edges.
Layer cheese, chicken mixed with beans and cumin, then more cheese on the base.
Fold the overhanging edges in and top with the 2 remaining tortillas, pressing down.
Spray the top and set a second sheet pan on it to press it flat.
Bake until golden and crisp, flipping once if you like. Center must reach 165°F.
Slice and serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Chicken nachos with queso
recipes.blurb: Loaded tortilla chips under a blanket of queso

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Spread the chips over a sheet pan and scatter chicken and beans.
Sprinkle with shredded cheese and bake until melted.
Warm the queso and drizzle it over the nachos.
Top with pico, avocado and jalapeños. Serve right away.

recipes.title: Huevos rancheros with ranchero sauce
recipes.blurb: Fried eggs on crisp tortillas with warm ranchero sauce

steps.text: Simmer the tomatoes, onion, jalapeño, cumin and a pinch of salt until thick.
Warm the refried beans in a small pot.
Crisp the tortillas in a dry or lightly oiled skillet.
Fry the eggs in oil until the whites are set.
Stack tortillas with beans and eggs, then spoon sauce and queso fresco over.

recipes.title: Chicken tostadas
recipes.blurb: Crisp tostada shells piled with chicken, beans and slaw

steps.text: Warm the refried beans and the chicken separately.
Spread beans on each tostada shell.
Top with chicken, lettuce and pico de gallo.
Finish with queso fresco, avocado and a drizzle of sour cream.

recipes.title: Turkey taco bowls
recipes.blurb: Quick taco-seasoned turkey over rice and crunchy veg

steps.text: Brown the turkey in a skillet until no pink remains.
Stir in the taco seasoning with 0.33 cup water and simmer. Turkey must reach 165°F.
Warm the beans and rice.
Fill bowls with rice, beans, turkey, lettuce, tomatoes and cheese.
Top with salsa.

recipes.title: Chicken enchilada soup
recipes.blurb: Creamy red enchilada flavor in a spoonable soup

steps.text: Sauté the onion in oil until soft, then add the garlic.
Add enchilada sauce, broth, chicken, beans and corn and simmer until the chicken is 165°F.
Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot.
Whisk in the cream cheese until melted.
Serve topped with shredded cheese.

recipes.title: Chicken fajita soup
recipes.blurb: All the fajita flavor with peppers, onions and lime

steps.text: Sauté the peppers and onion in oil until softened.
Add the chicken and fajita seasoning and cook for 3 minutes.
Add tomatoes and broth and simmer until the chicken is 165°F.
Stir in the lime juice and cilantro.

recipes.title: Slow cooker chicken taco soup
recipes.blurb: Set it in the morning, ladle it at dinner

ingredients.item: diced tomatoes with green chiles (10 oz)

steps.text: Put the chicken, beans, corn, tomatoes, broth and taco seasoning in the slow cooker.
Cook on low until the chicken is 165°F and shreds easily.
Shred the chicken with forks and stir it back in.
Whisk in the cream cheese and heat until melted.
Serve with cheddar and crushed chips.

recipes.title: Pozole verde with chicken
recipes.blurb: Tomatillo-green broth with hominy and tender chicken

steps.text: Simmer the chicken in the broth until 165°F, then lift out and shred.
Blend the tomatillos, poblanos, onion, garlic, cilantro and cumin with 1 cup broth until smooth.
Pour the green sauce into the pot and simmer.
Add the hominy and shredded chicken and simmer to blend flavors.
Season with salt and serve with sliced radishes.

recipes.title: Vegetarian tortilla soup
recipes.blurb: Smoky tomato broth with beans, corn and crisp strips

steps.text: Sauté the onion in oil until soft, then add the garlic, cumin and chili powder.
Add tomatoes and broth and simmer.
Add beans and corn and heat through.
Stir in the lime juice and season with salt.
Top bowls with avocado and tortilla strips.

recipes.title: Texas-style beef chili
recipes.blurb: Chunky beef in a deep red chili sauce, no beans

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in hot oil, then set aside.
Cook the onion in the pot until soft, then add garlic, chili powder and cumin.
Return the beef and add tomato sauce, broth and salt.
Simmer partly covered, stirring now and then, until the beef is very tender.
Adjust the salt and serve hot.

recipes.title: Black bean and sweet potato chili
recipes.blurb: Hearty vegan chili with sweet potato and smoky spice

steps.text: Cook the onion in oil until soft, then stir in chili powder and cumin.
Add the sweet potatoes, beans, tomatoes, broth and salt.
Simmer partly covered until the sweet potato is tender.
Stir in the lime juice and taste for salt.

recipes.title: Caldo de res
recipes.blurb: Mexican beef and vegetable soup, served with lime

steps.text: Cover the beef with the water, onion, garlic and salt and bring to a boil, skimming the foam.
Simmer gently until the beef is tender.
Add carrots, potatoes and corn and simmer.
Add the cabbage and zucchini and simmer until tender.
Ladle into bowls with the beef and serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex corn chowder
recipes.blurb: Creamy corn, potato and green chile chowder

steps.text: Cook the bacon until crisp, then lift out and leave 1 tbsp fat in the pot.
Cook the onion in the fat until soft.
Add potatoes, corn, chiles, cumin and broth and simmer until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the milk and cream and warm through without boiling.
Serve topped with bacon and cheddar.

recipes.title: Creamy poblano soup
recipes.blurb: Silky roasted poblano and potato soup with a squeeze of lime

steps.text: Broil the poblanos, turning, until blackened all over.
Steam the peppers in a covered bowl, then peel and seed them.
Cook the onion in butter until soft, then add the potato and broth and simmer until tender.
Blend the soup with the poblanos and cream until smooth.
Stir in lime juice and salt and top with crema.

recipes.title: Chipotle honey-lime chicken thighs
recipes.blurb: Sticky, smoky-sweet roasted thighs

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Whisk the chipotle, honey, lime juice, garlic, oil and salt.
Coat the thighs in the sauce and set them skin side up on a sheet pan.
Roast until the skin is browned and the chicken reaches 175°F at the thickest part.
Rest the chicken and spoon the pan juices over.

recipes.title: Chicken fajita pasta
recipes.blurb: Creamy Tex-Mex pasta with peppers and fajita chicken

steps.text: Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente, reserving 0.5 cup water, then drain.
Cook the chicken with the fajita seasoning in oil until 165°F, then set aside.
Cook the peppers and onion in the same pan until tender.
Add the broth and cream cheese and stir until smooth.
Stir in the pasta, chicken and cheese, loosening with pasta water as needed.

recipes.title: Cheesy salsa chicken bake
recipes.blurb: Three ingredients plus cheese, ready with little effort

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Rub the chicken with taco seasoning and set it in a baking dish.
Pour the beans and salsa over the chicken.
Bake until the chicken is nearly done.
Top with cheese and bake until melted and the chicken is 165°F.
Sprinkle with cilantro.

recipes.title: Grilled carne asada
recipes.blurb: Citrus-garlic marinated skirt steak with charred edges

steps.text: Whisk the juices, oil, garlic, cumin, cilantro and salt and pour over the steak in a zip bag.
Marinate in the fridge, but no longer than 4 hours.
Heat a grill to high and pat the steak dry.
Grill 3 to 4 minutes per side for medium (145°F).
Rest, then slice thinly against the grain.

recipes.title: Mexican pulled pork
recipes.blurb: Instant Pot pork in orange, chili and cumin

steps.text: Rub the pork with chili powder, cumin and salt.
Put onion, orange juice and broth in the Instant Pot, then add the pork.
Pressure cook on high, then let the pressure release naturally.
Shred the pork, which should reach at least 195°F for pulling, and mix with juices and lime juice.
Serve in tortillas, over rice or on buns.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex stuffed peppers
recipes.blurb: Bell peppers filled with beef, rice, beans and cheese

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Brown the beef and drain.
Stir in the rice, beans, salsa, taco seasoning and half the cheese.
Stand the peppers in a baking dish and fill them.
Cover with foil and bake until peppers are tender.
Uncover, add the remaining cheese and bake until the filling reaches 160°F.

recipes.title: Mexican meatloaf
recipes.blurb: Taco-spiced loaf with a salsa glaze

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F.
Mix the beef, chips, eggs, taco seasoning, half the salsa, cheese and cilantro gently.
Shape into a loaf on a lined sheet pan and spread the remaining salsa on top.
Bake until the center reaches 160°F.
Rest before slicing.

recipes.title: Chili-lime grilled shrimp
recipes.blurb: Skewered shrimp in a quick spicy-citrus marinade

steps.text: Whisk the oil, juice of 2 limes, garlic, chili powder and salt, then toss the shrimp in it for 15 minutes.
Thread the shrimp onto skewers and heat the grill to medium-high.
Grill until pink and opaque, 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Sprinkle with cilantro and squeeze over the last lime.

recipes.title: Pollo a la crema
recipes.blurb: Chicken in a silky poblano cream sauce

steps.text: Season the chicken with salt and sear in the butter 5 minutes per side.
Remove the chicken and cook the onion and poblanos in the pan until soft.
Add the broth and crema and return the chicken to the pan.
Simmer until the chicken is 165°F and the sauce is creamy.
Serve with rice and tortillas.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan chorizo and sweet potatoes
recipes.blurb: Spicy sausage, sweet potatoes and peppers on one pan

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the sweet potatoes with oil and salt on a sheet pan and roast.
Add the pepper, onion and crumbled chorizo and stir.
Roast until the chorizo reaches 160°F and the vegetables are tender.
Finish with lime juice and cilantro.

recipes.title: Cilantro-lime salmon
recipes.blurb: Pan-seared salmon with a bright cilantro-lime sauce

steps.text: Blend the cilantro, lime juice, garlic, 0.25 cup oil and half the salt into a sauce.
Season the salmon with cumin and the remaining salt.
Sear the fillets skin side down in 1 tbsp hot oil for 5 minutes.
Flip and cook until the salmon reaches 145°F.
Spoon the sauce over the fish.

recipes.title: King Ranch chicken casserole
recipes.blurb: Texas classic with chicken, tortillas and creamy chile sauce

ingredients.item: diced tomatoes with green chiles (10 oz)

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F.
Stir the soup, tomatoes with chiles, onion, broth and chili powder together.
Layer a third of the tortillas, chicken, sauce and cheese in a 9x13 dish and repeat twice.
Bake until bubbly and the center is 165°F.
Rest before serving.

recipes.title: Black bean and corn salsa
recipes.blurb: Fresh, chunky salsa for chips, tacos or bowls

steps.text: Stir the beans, corn, pepper, onion and cilantro together.
Whisk lime juice, oil and salt and pour over.
Chill for at least 30 minutes so the flavors blend.

recipes.title: Calabacitas
recipes.blurb: Zucchini, corn and green chile sautéed with a little cheese

steps.text: Cook the onion in oil until soft.
Add the zucchini and cook, stirring, until just tender.
Add the corn, chiles and salt and heat through.
Stir in the cheese until melted.

recipes.title: Cowboy caviar
recipes.blurb: Bean and veggie salad in zesty lime dressing

steps.text: Mix the beans, peas, corn, pepper, jalapeño, onion and cilantro.
Whisk lime juice, oil and salt, pour over and toss.
Chill so the flavors blend.
Fold in the avocado just before serving with chips.

recipes.title: Slow cooker pinto beans
recipes.blurb: Creamy beans from dried, with garlic and cumin

steps.text: Put the beans, onion, garlic, cumin and water in the slow cooker.
Cook on high until the beans are tender and creamy.
Stir in the salt and cook 15 more minutes, then taste and adjust.
Serve whole or mash some for a thicker broth.

recipes.title: Mango avocado salsa
recipes.blurb: Sweet and tangy, great on fish, chicken or chips

steps.text: Mix the mango, onion, jalapeño and cilantro.
Add the lime juice and salt.
Fold in the avocado gently just before serving.
